label: Soluble CD95L is a prognostic marker in central nervous system posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorders.
summary: CD95L is a transmembrane cytokine mainly expressed by activated T and natural killer cells to contract the immune response through cell-cell contact. Conversely, after cleavage by metalloproteases, this ligand releases a soluble CD95L (sCD95L) that stimulates the immune response and its antitumor activity.
